sn_aia_team.description: Gives a people manager a prioritised weekly team brief: overdue and due-soon follow-up actions, manager support requests waiting for approval, upcoming birthdays, work anniversaries and joiners, missing HR information and journeys at risk, each with a reason and a suggested next action. Use when a manager asks what to focus on this week, what is overdue in their team, or for a team brief.
sn_aia_team.name: Manager Team Brief Workflow
